title: Mental Health Sticker
author: Ahargun Craft Design
description:
Thank you for taking the time to view my mom life craft bundle. I made a variation of these which can be used for lots of different projects such as Card Making and T Shirt Printing. I have provided mycraft bundle in PNG format, which will also be useful for sublimation as well as SVGsfor crafters.
You will receive zip file. The zip file include this design with 6 formats.
WHAT’S INCLUDED
SVG
DXF
PNG (Transparent)
PDF
EPS
Files Contained:
love your self
more self love
you are enough
you are not alone
you matter
Please let me know if you have any questions, I’m always happy to help!
Thank you 🙂
